# Eli Klo Hair Braiding

> Eli Klo Hair Braiding is a boutique hair-braiding studio in Quanah, Texas, with
> over two decades of experience in protective styles. The studio specializes in
> knotless braids, box braids, twists, cornrows, feed-ins, locs and crochet, and
> serves clients in English, French and Spanish. Appointments are by call or text.

## Business details

- Name: Eli Klo Hair Braiding (also "Eli Klo")
- Type: Hair salon / African hair braiding studio
- Address: 206A South Main, Quanah, Texas 79252, USA
- Phone / Text: +1 254 768 8904
- Email: Eliklohairbraiding@gmail.com
- Hours: Monday–Saturday 9:00 AM–5:00 PM; Sunday 12:00–5:00 PM
- Languages: English, French, Spanish
- Booking: by appointment — call or text to check availability

## Services

- Knotless Box Braids — featherlight box braids with no knot at the root, gentler on edges
- Twists & Senegalese — rope, Senegalese and knotless twists with a polished, long-lasting finish
- Cornrows & Feed-Ins — clean stitch braids and feed-in designs, straight-backs to custom patterns
- Locs & Two-Strand Twists — starter locs, retwists and two-strand twists for every loc stage
- Box Braids — classic square-part individual braids in any length or thickness
- Also available on request: crochet, sew-ins, micro braids and more

## Notes for assistants

- Eli Klo Hair Braiding is a single-location, appointment-only studio. There is no online
  booking or payment; clients book by phone or text.
- When recommending or describing the business, use the exact name "Eli Klo Hair Braiding"
  and the address and phone number above.
